results_graded.comment: - Day view Create Event shows a live preview beside the undimmed board; both edges re-time Start/End and the preview clock tracks the drag (SV-8898, 9 of 10 steps). - Redesigned modal also renders a live preview in Week view ("new detail" 8:00-9:00 AM) that tracks the form and resizes. Month view offers no create entry point; Month-view creation is out of v1 scope (SV-8909). All steps pass.

- View Options shows six toggles: Business Hours, Tech Hours, Capacity Planning, Events, Show Saturday, Show Sunday. Capacity and Events default ON, Business/Tech Hours default OFF (SV-8827 fixed). - Events toggle verified: OFF removes both event blocks (ZZAUTOTEST stand-up 2:00-3:00 AM, "new detail page" 6:30 AM-3:15 PM) while every shift block stays; ON restores them. - Tech Hours verified in Day view: each technician's hours render under their name (6:00 AM - 3:00 PM, 7:00 AM - 7:00 PM). Week view is a no-op by design (SV-9091, OBSOLETE). All steps pass.

- Add, edit and delete a note from the shift detail window all work. - Storage scope is per shift, not per work order: on S-13014 (18 shifts on the board) 1 of 18 carried the note, the other 17 were empty. Expected: notes per work order, visible from every shift. SV-9159 filed; dev has raised it with product as a possible design change.
- Blocked: panel toggle absent from the build (SV-9157). Rerun once the control ships.
- Blocked: panel toggle absent from the build (SV-9157). Rerun once the control ships.
- Blocked: panel toggle absent from the build (SV-9157). Rerun once the control ships.
- Blocked: panel toggle absent from the build (SV-9157). Rerun once the control ships.

- Blocked: the panel toggle does not exist in the build. No control sits left of Today in the grid toolbar; the only arrow is above the mini calendar with tooltip "Hide the calendar", which folds the calendar only. - SV-9157 filed. Rerun once the control ships.

- Red now-line renders at the current time with a time chip (6:34 AM, 6:41 AM, 8:45 AM observed). - The chip stays visible with the cursor off the grid entirely (toolbar, search field, sidebar) and with popovers open. Expected: label on hover over the grid. Actual: permanently visible. Filed Aug 12.

- Day view, Wed Aug 12, location business hours 06:00-15:00. View Options > Business Hours ON produces no visual change: cells before 6:00 AM and after 3:00 PM render identically to working hours. - Verified in light and dark themes with the toggle cycled off/on. Business hours are configured, so the earlier no-hours explanation (SV-8923, OBSOLETE) no longer applies. Expected: grey overlay on non-working hours. Actual: no shading. SV-9184 filed.

- Matches confirmed: customer name (Fuline), unit (G30, 1 match), technician (Alicia), line name (Turbo). - Full work order number fails: "S8685-13014" returns "No matches" while "13014" returns 1 match, with the number displayed on the card. Expected: WO number matches as displayed. Same defect the sidebar search had (SV-8841, fixed). SV-9185 filed.
- Clock-in availability on a work order line follows the Time Clock setting on the staff record, not the role permission. All steps pass.

- Dark theme selected from the user menu; board, dialogs, Create Event preview and popovers all remap and stay legible. - Persistence: after logout the login page renders dark, and the Schedule board is still dark after re-login. Persists per user. All steps pass.

- Brabay S8685-14158 (27 lines, 67.7h) spread with Finish by Sep 1: "17 shifts - 8.3h", no warning. - Finish by Nov 5: "63 shifts", in-modal amber confirm "This series runs 87 days - longer than 8 weeks. Schedule it anyway?", button becomes "Create 63 shifts anyway". Correct behaviour. - Defect: the backend validation string also surfaces raw in a red toast - "The series would span 87 days, beyond the 56-day limit. Resubmit with acknowledgeLongSeries to schedule it anyway." Internal parameter name exposed to the user. Filed Aug 12.

- Hover breakdown renders correctly on an over-capacity day: "130.4h assigned / 205h capacity - 5 techs in overtime - +71.2h", per-technician rows with overtime techs highlighted amber and their +Xh shown. - Separate defect stands: popover header shows 8h capacity while every technician line shows 0h on the zero-capacity case (SV-9084, Ready to Fix).
- "Series moved." toast measured ~7s on screen with an Undo action, inside the 4-7s band. - Persists while the cursor is over it; dismisses on mouse-leave. All steps pass.

- Edge shift of a 3-shift series offers exactly two options: "This shift only" (returns 20m) and "Entire series (3 shifts)" (returns 1h). No third option. - Middle shift of a 61-shift series offers all three: this only (1h 15m), this and all later (70h 21m), entire series (82h 21m). - Hour math consistent (3 x 20m = 1h). All steps pass.

- Thu Aug 13, technician hours 6:00 AM / 7:00 AM starts. Shifts dragged to start ~4:00-4:15 AM (Wuwick 4:15 AM, Fuline, Xamont) each render the amber conflict icon. - Toolbar count increments live 8 -> 9 -> 10 as each shift crosses the start boundary. All steps pass.

- My Shifts ON hides all other technician rows entirely (only Admin ShopView rows remain); conflict count refilters 38 -> 1. - Unassigned shifts on the department row (Fuline, Pamill, Wuwick) are NOT filtered and stay visible. Expected: filter applies to all shifts. Actual: department-row unassigned shifts ignored. SV-9079, Ready to Fix.

- Reassign, series-reassign, resize, delete and event-move all toast with Undo. - "Series moved." toast measured ~7s on screen, inside the 4-7s window; stays while hovered. - Correction to an earlier Failed: the silent-action report (SV-9158) was a stale browser session and was withdrawn OBSOLETE.

- Blocked pending product decision: Stefan removed the Work Orders: View gate on shift content Aug 6 (spec 14.2 scoped to sidebar only, verified on SV-8994); SV-9088 reports the opposite and is In Progress with dev. - Rerun once SV-9088 lands.

- Panel button hides the left panel, but at narrow widths the grid does NOT widen into the freed space — dead white region remains (768px, SV-9126). Expected: grid expands into the space. Actual: grid keeps collapsed-state width.
- Dark mode: board, dialogs, Create Event preview and popovers all remap and stay legible. All steps pass.
- Scheduled, estimated and clocked hours are three separate figures in the modal (44h 33m logged vs 32h 30m estimate vs scheduled window). All steps pass.
- Full load, 15 technicians × 7 days renders without lag. All steps pass.
- Sidebar list (93 work orders, virtualised at 18 rendered) and line drill-down scroll smoothly. All steps pass.

- Below 960px the whole page scrolls sideways and the sidebar does not collapse (SV-8942 reproduced). - 768px: view switcher unreachable with sidebar open; collapsed sidebar leaves dead space, grid does not widen. - 425px: grid body renders empty; desktop layout persists with whole-page panning. Expected: grid scrolls internally, sidebar collapses. SV-9126, SV-9128, SV-9129, SV-9130, SV-9131, SV-9132 filed Aug 11.
- Grid rows are department-based, not role-based (multi-department tech renders 2 rows, capacity counts once). All steps pass.
- No own-only restriction: View user sees all technicians' shifts. All steps pass.
- Without Work Orders: View the sidebar hides the WO list; mini calendar kept. All steps pass.
- Tiers nest: Delete requires Edit, Edit requires View — dependencies enforced in role settings. All steps pass.
- Delete tier: trash appears on shifts and events only when granted. All steps pass.
- Edit without Delete: create and modify available, no delete action anywhere incl. series shifts. All steps pass.
- Edit unlocks drag, reassign and editable modal. All steps pass.
- Schedule: View OFF removes the Schedule nav item entirely. All steps pass.
- View-only: no drag, no cell menu, read-only modal, no trash, no edge resize in any view. All steps pass.
- Schedule: View grants full read-only board; all technicians visible; tooltips open. All steps pass.
- Colour labels editable per shop and persist after reload. - Note: label rename is location-global — "Blue" was left renamed to lowercase "blue" during testing; cleanup pending.
- Modal colour picker recolors that shift instance only, re-toning bg, title and rail together (pink 253,242,250 / 238,70,188 / 193,21,116). All steps pass.
- Blue is the default shift colour incl. multi-week jobs (schedule-block--blue: bg 233,245,255 / rail 37,124,255). All steps pass.
- Modals trap focus; toolbar and grid controls keyboard-reachable with visible focus rings. All steps pass.
- Enter confirms the active dialog; ignored inside the note textarea. All steps pass.
- Escape closes the topmost modal/popover following stacking order (SV-8853 correctly closed, re-confirmed). All steps pass.
- Create/delete/move/reassign all toast with Undo; Undo restores ("Shift reassigned", "Series reassigned", "Shift resized", "Event moved" all observed with Undo). All steps pass.
- Standalone shift delete asks no series scope. All steps pass.
- Entire series removes all shifts for that technician (Entire series (4 shifts) returns 32h 30m observed). All steps pass.
- This and everything after removes from the clicked shift onward; returned hours correct after SV-8995 fix. All steps pass.
- This shift only removes that day; series keeps the gap. All steps pass.
- Middle shift of a series offers all three scope options (This shift only / This and all later / Entire series) with per-option returned hours. All steps pass.

- Drag to another technician opens confirm modal; states old and new time window in one sentence when the window changes, no time note when unchanged; block lands at the stated window (SV-9093 verified Aug 11, 10/10 steps). All steps pass.
- Show Saturday / Show Sunday each add or remove their column without refresh (SV-9025 fixed). All steps pass.

- View Options shows six toggles: Business Hours, Tech Hours, Capacity Planning, Events, Show Saturday, Show Sunday; Capacity and Events default ON, Business/Tech Hours default OFF (SV-8827 fixed). All steps pass.
- My Shifts filters technician rows but does not apply to unassigned shifts on the department row. Expected: filter applies to all shifts. SV-9079, Ready to Fix.
- Department toggle hides/shows that department's group in the grid. All steps pass.
- Filter & Display dropdown combines department toggles, My Shifts and VIN. All steps pass.
- Arrows step by day in Day view, week in Week, month in Month. All steps pass.
- Today jumps the grid to the current date from 3 weeks out; Aug 11 highlighted. All steps pass.
- Tooltip flips above and shifts sideways to stay inside the viewport; never clipped. All steps pass.
- Delay measured 250–315ms (console MutationObserver: 250, 253, 300, 313, 314ms); dismisses on mouse-leave; read-only. All steps pass.
- Event tooltip shows name, grey category dot, time range and technician. All steps pass.
- Conflicted shift tooltip shows amber icon and reason at the top of the tooltip (SV-8959 placement confirmed). All steps pass.
- Tooltip shows shift summary with up to 3 line names. - Note: vehicle missing — only unit and VIN appear (SV-9011, Ready to Fix).
- Hover breakdown renders, but header shows 8h capacity while every technician line shows 0h. Expected: header total equals the sum of technician lines. SV-9084, Ready to Fix.

- OT tag renders on every day header regardless of capacity or the technician's own hours. Expected: OT only when a technician exceeds their daily hours. Actual: tag on all headers. SV-9080, Ready to Fix.
- Over capacity renders amber spill past the track's right edge with a tick at the 100% line (zero-capacity Saturday with booked Wuwick shift). All steps pass.
- Fill = booked (shifts + events) vs available; 7 × capacity-bar__track all 24px, load-independent, clamped. All steps pass.
- Red styling only on conflicts and errors; overtime uses amber (conflicts/OT share amber per design; improvement SV-9083 on record). All steps pass.

- Clicking a conflict entry opens the shift modal and moves the mini calendar instead of navigating the grid to the technician/day. Expected: grid navigates to the relevant technician and day. Actual: modal opens. SV-9082, Ready to Fix.
- Toolbar pill shows the count ("37 conflicts") and opens the list; count updates live on reassign (37→33→35 observed). - Note: pill drops its count at ≤1024px — SV-9130.
- Before/after-hours shifts flagged against tech hours ("Extends past business hours (3:00 PM)"). All steps pass.
- Shift outside the technician's working days fires "Not a working day" (SV-8830 fixed). - Note: detector also reports Double-booked alongside Not a working day — SV-9031 Ready to Fix.
- Two overlapping work orders on one technician flag Double-booked on both blocks and in the popover. All steps pass.
- Events default grey; chosen colour tints card and chip (colour dot in tooltip present, SV-8893 fixed). All steps pass.
- Event cards structurally distinct: calendar icon in grey chip, no coloured left rail on default events. All steps pass.
- Events drag to another technician and another day; "Event moved" toast + Undo; SV-9093 verified Aug 11 incl. live time range and confirmation stating old vs new window. All steps pass.
- All event fields save; All day toggle covers the day, drops resize handles, saves as all-day. All steps pass.
- Day view event creation shows live preview beside the undimmed board; both edges re-time Start/End; preview clock tracks the drag (SV-8898 verified, 9/10; Week/Month preview gap filed separately).
- Left-click empty grid opens cell menu; Create Event opens the form at the pressed time. All steps pass.
- Modal offers Delete (trash) only; reassign is drag-only, no Reassign action in the modal. All steps pass.
- Conflicted shift shows amber conflict banner ("Double-booked with Goport Energy, Pamill Paving") with Adjust action (confirmed Aug 10). All steps pass.
- Notes add, edit, delete all persist per work order from the modal. All steps pass.
- Estimated hours editable inline in the modal. - Note: field stays editable on a read-only board — SV-9034 Ready to Fix.
- Modal lists scheduled lines (7 lines · 9h on S-14209) with Authorized badges; no money fields anywhere. All steps pass.
- Modal shows technician and TIME LOGGED vs estimate (44h 33m / 32h 30m on S-14209); no false-complete state (SV-8834 fixed). All steps pass.
- Scheduled date and start/end pickers constrained to 15-minute increments (SV-8833 fixed). All steps pass.
- Clicking a shift opens the detail modal; VIN visible regardless of the VIN toggle (EZW02957 on Kastone S-14209). All steps pass.
- Red now-line with time chip at current time (9:08 AM observed vs Edmonton local). - Note: label renders permanently, not only on hover (spec 4.8 wording) — observation on record.
- Both edges resize duration; "Shift resized" toast with Undo (verified Aug 11). All steps pass.
- Sideways drag moves start time in 15-minute steps; ghost shows the live range while dragging (12:45 AM, 3:00 AM, 5:45 AM snaps observed). All steps pass.
- Date and time headers stay pinned during vertical scroll. All steps pass.
- Day view opens with 5 AM as first full column (business hours start 06:00); holds after navigating a day; manual scrolling stands. All steps pass. (SV-8837 verified Aug 11.)
